title: Evaluation Report
description: Evaluator's assessment of a sprint against the sprint contract rubric. Output by the Evaluator role.

sprintId.description: ID of the sprint being evaluated (matches sprint-contract.sprintId).

evaluationTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when evaluation was completed.

rubricScores.description: Scores for each criterion in the sprint contract.

criterion.description: Name of the criterion (matches sprint-contract rubric).

passed.description: Whether this criterion passed (true) or failed (false).

score.description: Numeric score (0–1), where 1 is perfect pass.

evidence.description: Specific evidence or test output supporting this score (e.g., 'test suite output', 'build log').

overallScore.description: Weighted average score across all criteria (0–1).

failedCriteria.description: List of criteria that failed (subset of rubricScores where passed=false).

generatorFeedback.description: Specific feedback for generator if recommendation is FAIL or CONDITIONAL_PASS (e.g., 'Fix test failures in UserService').

evaluatorNotes.description: Additional notes from the evaluator (e.g., 'Test coverage improved by 5% but still below threshold').

artifactLocations.description: Paths to evaluation artifacts (test logs, browser screenshots, etc.).
